items.caption: A seal-script form of 天, preserved here as a modern redraw. Paleographic analyses of earlier forms interpret 天 as a standing person with the head marked, but this seal-script form does not resolve whether “head/top” or “sky” was the word’s earliest meaning.
items.alt: Black seal-script glyph on a white background, with a long horizontal stroke above a human-like form whose lower strokes spread apart.
items.selection_reason: This legible form provides a historical script example for 天. Its caption keeps the interpretation of earlier head-marked forms separate from what this later form can establish.

limitations.text: This modern redraw represents a seal-script form, not a dated inscription. The earliest spoken meaning of 天 and any sequence between head/top and sky or heaven remain unresolved.
